notes.title: Shopkeepers Tale Update 3.09.2021
notes.content:
Shopkeepers Tale Update 3.09.2021

Shopkeepers Tale is currently in Test Mode. ( You start in shop past all cutscenes)
						
Added New Mercenary : Colwyn, the Aqua Lancer



NPC CHANGES:


Venom (enemy/pet) Starting Attack Power Adjusted.( 20 -> 11 )
reason: They were way too had to defeat if encountered too early.




Technical Changes. 

In some instances players were still getting the "Portal Brace Teleport" Bug when leaving the dungeon.
This system has been changed and tested over and over. If you encounter this bug simply just teleport again.


Quest changes. 

Changed Snipper Slayer quest Reward. 






Item Changes:

Added Snipper Statue.



Noted Fixes to come


1. Your total completion is being counted but not shown in "Provisions!" Quest. 
2. hatched in battle npcs Hp/MP Status not updating correctly.
3. Traps/puzzles resetting upon re-entering the dungeon.
4. Some red chest items not being removed from player inventory when leaving dungeon.

notes.title: Shopkeepers Tale Update 6.12.2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33635961/7e9102a20421f2efc339efed1ba34ed9bd72041b.png[/img]

Shopkeepers Tale Update 6.12.2020

- Fixed "Black Screen Teleportation Bug" (for the FINAL time) You will no longer get stuck sometimes when teleporting out of the dungeon using the portal brace. The entire process has been rebuilt from the inside. The only change you should notice to teleporting is that now it happens much faster and you won't ever bug.

- New sound effects when accepting quest and jobs.

- Stinger enemy stats nerfed "Slowing sting was just destroying people"

- New (4) dungeon floors added to Underground Waterway.

- Underground waterways battle music and victory fanfare has been updated.

- New party members join sound effects.

- [SHIFT UI Day Count] Day Number now correctly displays when holding [SHIFT] to see the player UI.

- Noel Item Request event has been removed temporarily.

- Some shoppers may act weird there are ongoing internal reworks on how the shoppers work.


_UPCOMING UPDATES_

- Random;y appearing Traders, Merchants, and Mercenary NPCs.

- Additional Cutscenes and Story dialog.

- Shopper rework.

- Updated UI for familiar feeding.

- Online Multiplayer.

- As work continues on Shopkeepers Tale we strive to listen and address any issues players may have with the game. please email  shopkeeperrpg@gmail.com or join the official discord for help with any problems that may occur
